title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Anubhav
desc: Married couple Meeta and Amar have no time for intimacy because he is a workaholic. Then Meeta starts working, thus throwing their marriage in jeopardy.

title: Code Name: Tiranga
desc: An undercover agent sets out to avenge the 2001 terrorist attacks on Indian soil, but her pursuit of justice soon leads her to a dangerous point of no return.

title: Race 3
desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

title: Coolie No. 1 (2020)
desc: When a matchmaker is insulted by Jeffrey Rozario, a rich businessman, he vows to exact revenge. As a result, he makes a porter pretend to be a rich man and marries him off to Rozario's daughter.

title: Butterfly
desc: Two children are kidnapped. To find them, authorities launch Operation Butterfly, and the story shows several intercut scenes of the search as the investigation unfolds with multiple perspectives.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Kites
desc: Jay, a Las Vegas dance teacher, marries women for green cards. He weds Natasha for the same reason but unexpectedly falls in love when they reunite, complicating his plans.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Kedarnath
desc: Mansoor, a gentle Muslim porter, falls for Mukku, the bold and free-spirited daughter of a Hindu priest. But their blossoming love is tested by deep misunderstandings and the fury of nature.

title: Seeta Aur Geeta
desc: Seeta runs away from her cruel aunt. Her look-alike Geeta takes over but gets arrested. Seeta is forced back into a life of suffering.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl, who is speech impaired, lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she belongs to Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Baby John
desc: DCP Satya Verma fakes his death to shield his daughter from a deadly politician. But when enemies return, he must face his past to protect his family at all costs.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Two ambitious rivals chase wealth by pursuing an heiress, but their plans spiral into confusion when a family plot and hidden identity create unexpected trouble.

title: Singham Again
desc: Drawing parallels to the Ramayana, Bajirao Singham leads his team on a daring mission to rescue his wife while facing a powerful and mysterious enemy.

title: Ragini MMS 2
desc: Ragini's viral video sparks buzz. A sleazy filmmaker sets his next horror movie in the same haunted house-only to stir the evil that still lurks in its shadows.

title: Suhaag
desc: Ajay and Raj, notorious college pranksters, constantly land in trouble. When Ajay applies for a passport, he uncovers a shocking secret about his real identity, changing his life.
